verdicts.reason: Both break the product badge the same way: the cream circle behind the can ends up in the bottom-left corner, clipped by the canvas edge. That leaves the can body orange on orange, so only a floating label and stray green dots show. Both also have a small headline, a tiny 'Out now.' cut off from it, large dead areas and a small CTA. A is marginally worse because its can and headline are smaller and its spacing more cramped; B's slightly larger product and headline read a little better but have the same flaws.
